WELCOME TO DHEMAJI CITY COLLEGE
Dhemaji City College, formerly known as Dhemaji Girls’ College, is today a premier higher education institution situated in Dhemaji District. The college was established in 1986 and, since its inception, has sincerely rendered service in imparting higher education at the UG level while devotedly working for the all-round development of students and contributing to community service, as expected of a higher education institution. Though the college was founded in 1986, in the beginning it offered only UG level courses. Dibrugarh University accorded permission to start UG courses in 1994.
The active involvement of the college in disseminating knowledge and its assiduous performance within its precincts pleased Dibrugarh University to extend affiliation in 2001 for the ongoing Arts courses. In the years to come, the college obtained UGC’s 2f on 12th April, 2010 and 12B on 21st January, 2011. The college was provincialized under the Provincialization Act by the Government of Assam in 2014, with effect from 14th August, 2013.

Dear all,

Dhemaji City College (Formerly Dhemaji Girls’ College)

The Foundation of the realization of the dream of the common poor people of this flood affected

Dhemaji City College
